 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE S. B. PD. SINGH

ORAL ORDER 2 05-12-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2.

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Bihra P.S. Case No. 155 of 2019 for the offence under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120B of the I.P.C.
3.

As per the prosecution story, the informant has alleged that the land in question was sold to the father of the informant on 27.07.1964 through sale deed no. 7365 which was later on mutated in the name of father of informant vide Jamabandi bearing no. 2371 and since then the land in question is in possession of informant and his father.

It is alleged against the petitioner that he in conspiracy with co-accused and others got the said land mutated in the name of his father who had died 30 years ago and now trying to sale the aforesaid land.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.84277 of 2025(2) dt.05-12-2025 case.
The alleged mutation/jamabandi was created in the name of deceased father of the petitioner which has already been cancelled by the authority concerned on the application submitted by the informant.
Moreover, the matter is purely civil in nature, as such, the initiation of criminal proceedings is impermissible in the eye of law.
The petitioner is a man of clean antecedents, with no criminal history.
5. Learned APP opposes the prayer for bail.

6. Keeping in view the aforesaid facts, this Court is inclined to extend him the privilege of Md. Habib @ Md. Haviv vs The State Of Bihar on 5 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183614266/
1 anticipatory bail.
7. Let the petitioner be released on bail in the event of arrest or surrender within a period of four weeks from the date of receipt of this order, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/-(Ten thousand)
each with two sureties of like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Saharsa, in connection with Bihra P.S. Case No. 155 of 2019 subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 482 of B.N.S.S., as also with the condition that one of the bailors should be close relative of the petitioner.
